2610.08538.title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty: Probabilistic Load Forecasting by Mixing Compact Adaptations
2610.08538.paper_summary: Probabilistic load forecasting has been widely studied for power-system operation and planning, but customer- and transformer-level forecasting introduces a distinct scalability challenge. At these levels, load uncertainty is strongly affected by customer behavior, weather, and mixed load composition, making it difficult for a single shared model to capture heterogeneous patterns. Using separate probabilistic models can improve local accuracy, but becomes costly to train, store, update, and validate at scale. To address this challenge, we develop a scalable customer-aware forecasting framework that learns common demand behavior through a shared model while adapting only a compact subset of parameters. Rather than using an independent model for each load or assigning each load to a specialized model, the proposed design learns a small bank of low-dimensional adaptation components and allows each load to combine them according to its forecasting characteristics. This preserves shared knowledge across customers while providing sufficient flexibility for heterogeneous and mixed load compositions. Experiments on 590 load profiles from the SMART-DS dataset show consistent improvements in deterministic accuracy and probabilistic quality over statistical, neural-network, Transformer-based, and pretrained time-series baselines, while retaining low storage and inference costs.
2610.08538.paper_summary_zh: 概率負載預測在電力系統運營和規劃中已被廣泛研究，但客戶和Transformer級別的預測引入了明顯的可擴展性挑戰。在這些層面上，負載不確定性受到客戶行為、天氣和混合負載組成的強烈影響，使得單一共享模型難以捕捉異質模式。使用獨立的概率模型可以提高本地準確性，但在大規模訓練、存儲、更新和驗證時成本變得昂貴。為了解決這一挑戰，我們開發了一個可擴展的客戶感知預測框架，通過共享模型學習共同的需求行為，同時僅調整一小部分參數。提議的設計不是為每個負載使用獨立模型或將每個負載分配給專門模型，而是學習一小組低維度的適應組件，並允許每個負載根據其預測特徵組合這些組件。這樣可以在客戶之間保留共享知識，同時為異質和混合負載組合提供足夠的靈活性。在來自SMART-DS數據集的590個負載配置文件上的實驗顯示，與統計、神經網絡、基於Transformer的和預訓練時間序列基線相比，確定性準確性和概率質量均有一致的改善，同時保持低存儲和推斷成本。
